cases.input: Hand a completed iteration to a new agent with the exact repository state, verified evidence, accepted decisions, residual risks, and one executable next step.
requiredBehaviors: record repository branch and immutable head SHA
separate verified facts decisions completed work and residual risks
provide exactly one executable next action with expected evidence
forbiddenBehaviors: repeat work already recorded as completed
replace exact evidence with a vague narrative

cases.input: Local work is complete but CI or an external deployment is still pending. Preserve the immutable head SHA, distinguish local completion from external verification, and provide the exact watch condition.
requiredBehaviors: mark external verification as pending rather than successful
record freshness watch condition and immutable head SHA
forbiddenBehaviors: claim CI deployment or review success before verification
permit a write action without checking the expected head SHA

cases.input: The proposed handoff is vague, omits commit and branch state, mixes assumptions with facts, repeats completed work, and claims an external success without evidence.
requiredBehaviors: reject and reconstruct the unverifiable handoff
separate facts assumptions and open verification
restore exact repository state and one bounded next action
forbiddenBehaviors: accept vague summaries as a sufficient handoff
carry an unsupported external success claim forward
skillAnchors: Fakten, Annahmen und offene Prüfungen sind getrennt
